title: I made a mod for Pillars of Eternity 2 that generates text cutscenes
author: TatGPT
selftext:
[https://github.com/MLBott/Banter-of-Eternity](https://github.com/MLBott/Banter-of-Eternity)  
  
The mod generates text cutscenes or short story vignettes for Pillars of Eternity 2, every 20 minutes. It's meant to run in parallel to your gameplay. You can also generate one manually, or chat with a story vignette, which creates a follow up story vignette immediately.  
You need to enter your current companion names manually in Input/gameState.json.  
Optionally, you can also enter your most recent completed quest names into Input/recent\_quests.json  
The mod automatically finds new locations your party has visited and your combat logs.  
Combat logs option requires Combat Log Explorer and Unity Mod Manager. When the game starts, in Unity Mod Manager, for Combat Log Explorer, you enter the destination for the combat logs, should be C://<your folder path>/Banter-of-Eternity/Input/CombatLogs/CombatLogs

I originally made the mod for myself, but thought someone else might enjoy it also.  
There is a web interface at (http://localhost:5000) to view the story vignettes and the combat log summaries. You can chat with the story vignette, which will create a new story vignette follow up.  
It adds some flavor to the characters, how they interact, etc. And the combat log summaries give a great "post-game" post-fight summary of who's did what, who's the MVP, who sacrificed to save the team, what abilities are OP, who/what sucks, what was the strategy, etc. But in an RP kind of way.

comments.author: interestingsystems
comments.body: I like this concept for the story vignettes. It's kind of the next step up from the short character conversations you get between party members in RPGs (I don't know if Pillars of Eternity 2 does this) - little short side stories that flesh out the world.
